propositions: When an LLM call is blocked by a content policy (Bedrock Guardrail or Anthropic refusal), the operator message incorrectly reports 'too large / malformed' instead of naming the actual content-filter cause.
The finish_reason=content_filter case requires a distinct operator message that does not reference size or format issues.
message_for() must accept an optional finish_reason parameter and branch to a new CONTENT_FILTER_MESSAGE when both resolution_class=CHANGE_INPUT and finish_reason=content_filter.
Genuine CHANGE_INPUT cases (HTTP 413, context-length overflow) must retain the existing generic message to avoid over-broadening.
finish_reason must be threaded through from LLMOutcome.diagnostic and persisted coverage diagnostic to all three render sites.
